steps.name: Before Hooks
Navigate to CAN home page
Open Mattamy Homes home page for CAN in STAGE
Verify home page loaded
Home page should finish loading
Home page title should include Mattamy Homes
Open Design Studio from the Resources menu
Verify Design Studio is not a top-level nav link
Click 'Resources' menu link: Design Studio
Open 'Resources' menu
Design Studio should be visible in the Resources menu
Resources menu navigation: Design Studio https://stagemh-sc.exsquared.com/design-studio
Verify Design Studio landing
Page shell did not hydrate - header is still the mobile SSR shell, so desktop navigation and the country selector are unreliable https://stagemh-sc.exsquared.com/design-studio
Design Studio entry point https://stagemh-sc.exsquared.com/design-studio
Validate page shell
Validate Design Studio page shell
Design Studio title should match expected value
Design Studio should keep the expected route
Design Studio should keep the global header mounted
Design Studio should render a main content area
Design Studio should keep the global footer mounted
